notes: IMDuelToken (src/IMDuelToken.sol) is a fixed-supply, self-contained ERC-20: name IMDuel, symbol IMDUEL, 18 decimals. Its constructor takes no arguments and mints the whole supply of 1,000,000,000 IMDUEL (1000000000000000000000000000 minor units) once to msg.sender, which in this launch is the factory; the factory then pays it all out. totalSupply() is a compile-time constant with no mint path, so the supply can never grow. Transfers carry no fee, burn, tax or reflection, so the transfers to the MerkleDistributor, the pool seed through the PoolManager, claims and swaps all move exactly what they say, and the token takes none of the launch addresses because there is nothing to exempt. There is no owner, pause, blocklist, freeze, upgrade path, delegatecall, callcode or selfdestruct. transferFrom spends only the allowance granted to msg.sender; an allowance of type(uint256).max is unlimited. This launch deploys no application contracts and makes no initialization calls. Pool: paired with IMD at 0xd34a99bc0f67ae1bbd63c660e6d0b0dd03e263b7, fee 12500 (1.25%), tick spacing 60; initialPrice is provenance only and the deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei (2,500 IMD) and the total supply. Economics are the requester's, copied verbatim: 80% of the supply seeds the pool and the remainder of the requester's share goes to 0xff3e8d9ba776662ca6ed1420ee366afb436d2684.
